decision_policy.summary: Record the unresolved check, or ready if all six checks pass. At most one check is unresolved in any scenario, so no priority order is needed.
design_rationale: Every variable corresponds to a published PLOS policy.
The benchmark assumes study-specific ethics and format checks are already satisfied.

Scenarios contain at most one unresolved check (generation_plan.invalid_configurations excludes every pair of unresolved states), so each non-ready outcome names that check and the rules are mutually exclusive; rule order is presentational.
Real submission reviews often find several open items at once; restricting to one is a benchmark scoping choice that removes any dependence on a priority order.
A preprint is explicitly distinguished from concurrent journal consideration.
Ready means administratively ready under the six scoped checks, not acceptable for publication.
